name: quotex-trade-engine
description: Developer scripts only. Run with `npm run <name>` from the repository root.

scripts.setup: uv sync --directory backend && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run db:upgrade
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.check: npm run api:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.api:generate: npm run api:export && npm run api:types
scripts.api:check: uv run --directory backend python -m scripts.export_openapi --check && npm --prefix frontend run api:types:check
scripts.db:upgrade: uv run --directory backend alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:downgrade: uv run --directory backend alembic downgrade base
scripts.telegram:login: uv run --directory backend python -m scripts.telegram_cli login
scripts.telegram:dialogs: uv run --directory backend python -m scripts.telegram_cli dialogs
scripts.telegram:listen: uv run --directory backend python -m scripts.telegram_cli listen
